# Thom Griggs

> Web production specialist and front-end developer in St. Petersburg, Florida. I help marketing, creative, and digital teams build, update, troubleshoot, and QA websites, landing pages, CMS content, HTML/CSS layouts, and email campaigns.

- CMS updates and content production (WordPress, Squarespace, custom CMS)

- Responsive design implementation

- Recent work: Westbrooke Place HOA, Tinatin's Piano Studio, Executive Presence site and assessment emails, Genox forms, Tampa Bay Community Design Center, Optimum RV, Qlik Support Portal
